scope: Prepared open smith, lumber and carpenter worksite fixture using real current GLBs, real workStation placement and jobPose motion. Starting browser storage is an isolated earned Forge save, then renderer state is replaced by the labeled fixture. Actors placed at their valid stations to separate pose review from traffic. No user save, production code or asset is changed. Camera zoom is diagnostic close-up, below normal gameplay zoom. Anvil measurements use actual transformed hammer-head vertices against authored face bounds.
